verdict.rationale: PagerDuty documents generally available AI-generated Post-Incident Reviews that teams start from the incident detail page or Slack after resolution. The reviews draw on the incident lifecycle, Slack data and Scribe Agent meeting transcripts to build chronological incident narratives, surface systemic patterns and coordinate preventative follow-up actions, which covers the timeline and follow-ups. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that the AI draft includes contributing factors (only 'systemic patterns' is stated), detail on what the AI generates versus what humans fill in during review, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
